say:2:1511224001:1.text: Hem, what's the matter? Why does everyone look so troubled?
say:2:1511224001:1.source_cn: 赫，出什么事了？为什么大家满脸困扰？

say:4:1511224003:1.text: Another of his warriors just came by. Hunting's been poor lately, and now Mirehold has to send more wheat to Wrathwood Grove.
say:4:1511224003:1.source_cn: 刚刚又有他派来的战士来传令，说最近狩猎到的猎物越来越少...

say:6:1511224005:1.text: He says the warriors are risking their lives during the hunts, so they deserve more. That's their idea of fairness, apparently.
say:6:1511224005:1.source_cn: 哼，说是战士刀尖舔血，贡献更多，这是合理的分配。

say:7:1511224006:1.text: How did things go in Wrathwood Grove, Gala? Did Kordan listen to you?
say:7:1511224006:1.source_cn: 加拉，树怒山谷那边怎么样。你去劝戈丹，他听进去了吗？

say:8:1511224007:1.source_cn: 和之前一样，他比较……固执。

say:9:1511224008:1.text: That old fool... even you can't reason with him.
say:9:1511224008:1.source_cn: 啧，那个老顽固，连你也没办法。

say:10:1511224009:1.text: Gala, you're the High Priestess. Whether it's you or Tilaya, either of you would do well to claim his seat as chief!
say:10:1511224009:1.source_cn: 加拉，你是巫祭之首。你或者缇洛亚，谁去夺了他的首领之位都好！

say:13:1511224011:1.text: Let me explain... Ever since the Hunting Goddess perished, the wilds have run amok. The beasts breed unchecked, fiercer than before, and the hunters can no longer maintain the balance.
say:13:1511224011:1.source_cn: 是这样……自从狩猎神陨落，丛林里的野兽繁衍生息都不再规...

say:14:1511224012:0.text: In the war against the Halians, our young warriors suffered heavy casualties, and the newer generation has not yet matured. What Kordan said about hunting being difficult was the truth.
say:14:1511224012:0.source_cn: 在与呼临的战争中，年轻力壮的战士牺牲惨重，新一代还未成...

say:15:1511224013:1.text: Fortunately, many of the Wildborn can survive solely on wheat. Most of them migrated from Wrathwood Grove to Mirehold.
say:15:1511224013:1.source_cn: 幸好雅库伯尔内有不少人只依靠小麦制成的食物就能活下去，...

say:16:1511224014:1.text: We may not be suitable for hunting, but we are still useful to the Wildborn. Kordan thinks we're nothing but cowards.
say:16:1511224014:1.source_cn: 我们身体不适合追猎，但也对雅库伯尔有用，戈丹却认为我们懦弱。

say:17:1511224015:1.text: Some mighty warriors they are. Think they're better than us until their bellies are empty and they come begging us "weaklings" for a scrap of bread.
say:17:1511224015:1.source_cn: 哼，自称为强者，看不起我们，却反过头伸手向我们这些“弱...

say:18:1511224016:1.text: Since ancient times, the priestesses have read the signs for the Wildborn and guided our tribe's path. But Kordan has proclaimed our goddess dead and the craft obsolete. Now, the priestesses can only live with us.
say:18:1511224016:1.source_cn: 自古以来，巫祭都在为雅库伯尔占卜大事，为部落指点方向，...

say:19:1511224017:1.text: He was once the strongest of us all, but there's not much left of the man he was.
say:19:1511224017:1.source_cn: 戈丹曾经勇健强壮，但他的心和躯体已经被岁月风化了！

choice_prompt:20:1511224017.text: He was once the strongest of us all, but there's not much left of the man he was.
choice_prompt:20:1511224017.source_cn: 戈丹曾经勇健强壮，但他的心和躯体已经被岁月风化了！

say:21:1511224018:1.text: Well, most of the people I know are here. As for Kordan... I think he's a bit wary of me.
say:21:1511224018:1.source_cn: 嗯，我所熟悉的人大多都在这边。戈丹……他对我有些提防。

say:22:1511224021:1.text: Let's talk about something else for now. Hem, you know more of the world than most. Have you, by any chance, heard talk of Utopia?
say:22:1511224021:1.source_cn: 先不提这些了。赫，你见多识广，或许会知道理想乡的传闻来...

say:23:1511224022:1.text: Yeah, I've heard of it. This is what happens when the priestesses aren't allowed to divine the future. Rumors like these will start to spread.
say:23:1511224022:1.source_cn: 听过。哼，不让巫祭占卜预测，就会生出这种流言。

say:24:1511224023:1.text: Give anyone a mouth, and they'll give you a problem. And problems breed like flies on manure. Next thing you know, you're dealing with a whole heap bigger than you started with!
say:24:1511224023:1.source_cn: 谁都能说话，就谁都能提出问题。问题就是蜣螂滚的球，会越...

choice_prompt:25:1511224023.text: Give anyone a mouth, and they'll give you a problem. And problems breed like flies on manure. Next thing you know, you're dealing with a whole heap bigger than you started with!
choice_prompt:25:1511224023.source_cn: 谁都能说话，就谁都能提出问题。问题就是蜣螂滚的球，会越来越多，越来越大！

say:26:1511224024:1.text: Oh, right, Utopia. The younglings mentioned it. It seems that they saw it on a piece of <style="highlight">paper</style>.
say:26:1511224024:1.source_cn: 噢，理想乡。年轻的孩子们提起过，他们好像是在<styl...

say:27:1511224025:1.text: The Wildborn don't use paper much. The rumors must've come from outside. Either the Halians or the mages. You should talk to them.
say:27:1511224025:1.source_cn: 纸，太脆弱了，雅库伯尔不用这种东西，流言肯定是从外面来...

say:28:1511224026:1.text: A scroll from the Halians... <style="highlight">Things like that are stored where the priestesses live.</style>
say:28:1511224026:1.source_cn: 如果是从呼临易物来的卷轴，都会存放在<style=hi...

say:29:1511224027:1.text: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let's go look over there.
say:29:1511224027:1.male: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let's go look over there.
say:29:1511224027:1.female: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let's go look over there.

choice:25:0:1.text: Alright, let's get down to business.
choice:25:0:1.male: Alright, let's get down to business.
choice:25:0:1.female: Alright, let's get down to business.

choice:25:1:2.text: Can we get back on topic?
choice:25:1:2.male: Can we get back on topic?
choice:25:1:2.female: Can we get back on topic?

choice:20:0:1.text: Is that why you all came to Mirehold?
choice:20:0:1.source_cn: 你们也是因此来到水泽营地的？
choice:20:0:1.male: Is that why you all came to Mirehold?
choice:20:0:1.female: Is that why you all came to Mirehold?

say:32:1511224020:1.text: Even if she were here, she couldn't have saved our standing. The truth is our goddess is gone. But that doesn't mean our work is over. There's still magic in the world. There's still a way for me to serve the Wildborn.
say:32:1511224020:1.source_cn: 即使她还在，也无法阻止巫祭地位下降，毕竟神已经死去……...

choice:12:0:1.text: What has happened over the years?
choice:12:0:1.male: What has happened over the years?
choice:12:0:1.female: What has happened over the years?

choice:12:1:2.text: Are the internal issues that bad?
choice:12:1:2.source_cn: 雅库伯尔内部的矛盾这么大吗？
choice:12:1:2.male: Are the internal issues that bad?
choice:12:1:2.female: Are the internal issues that bad?
